prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for interlocking patterns and natural motion. Instruments: kora, calabash, shakers, soft bass. 112 BPM in 4/4. Motif: an offbeat three-note arch and held answer. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat, energetic, and positive Latin-inspired instrumental track featuring a prominent acoustic guitar melody, supported by a lively bassline, percussion, and subtle synth pads.
